prompt: Here's a NestJS/KafkaJS consumer from our ad-click analytics pipeline — it dedupes incoming click events by `clickId` before folding them into per-minute window counts, so a Kafka retry/redelivery doesn't get double-counted. It works fine for a while, but in production the process eventually OOMs, and every time it crashes and restarts, the reported ad counts come out wrong. Walk me through why, then optimize the deduplication so memory stays bounded and it survives a restart — talk me through the trade-offs of whatever approach you land on.
